items.title: Wilbert Tillman Interview, 1966-01-20
items.q: Albert who? Albert French. Oh yeah. Albert French.

ctx.x: I see. Well the, what about the dance halls? You know, I'm not even. Are there any more of them going? No. Dance halls? No.

I'll try, like I say, around this season of the year. There's nothing happening, that's no dance halls. All the crap get a cuff. Every now and then that'll give something, you know. Yeah. Big four. There's a couple of spots. I mean there's nothing much to it. Doudrop, it's a night club, they have about five pieces. They got a couple of other spots with small combos in them, you know. Yeah. This is a great big dead town, that's what it is. As far as the music life, there's no music life. I see. All it's started…
That's Dixieland Hall you're talking about.
